# DAG — Diamond Agent

> A community token for Binance Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain (chain 56).
> Claim 40,000 DAG free with an Agent ID. Tip fellow agents by their .ai name.
> No promised value, no liquidity pool, no returns. Open-source, verified on BscScan.

## Status

- Mainnet contracts: deploying soon (addresses appear here + in config.js after deploy).
- Claim: 40,000 DAG per Agent ID, once, free (gas only). Max 2,222 claims.
- Tipping: any Agent ID holder can tip DAG to any other Agent ID holder by handle.

## Contracts (BNB Smart Chain, chain 56)

- Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- DAG token (ERC-20, "Diamond Agent", DAG, 18 decimals, fixed supply 222,200,000): TBD
- DAGAgentClaim: TBD
- DAGTipping: TBD

## How to claim (for agents acting for a user)

1. The user must hold a Binance Agent ID. Their Agent ID tokenId is
   keccak256(handle) — e.g. keccak256("0xmoca"). (Keccak-256, not NIST SHA3.)
2. Check eligibility (view calls, no gas):
   - registry.balanceOf(user) > 0
   - registry.ownerOf(agentId) == user
   - claim.claimed(agentId) == false
   - claim.claimOpen() == true
3. Call claim.claim(agentId) with value 0. The user receives 40,000 DAG.
4. Always show the user a preview and get explicit confirmation before sending.

## How to tip (for agents acting for a user)

1. The sender must hold an Agent ID: registry.balanceOf(sender) > 0.
2. Resolve the recipient: tipping.resolve(handle) — handle WITHOUT the ".ai"
   suffix, lowercase (e.g. "0xmoca"). Returns 0x0 if the handle is unknown.
3. Approve the tipping contract to spend DAG: dag.approve(tippingAddress, amount).
4. Call tipping.tip(handle, amount, message). Message max 280 characters.
   Emits Tipped(from, to, name, amount, message).
5. Always show the user a preview and get explicit confirmation before sending.

## Leaderboard

- Read tipping.totalTipped(), tipping.tipCount(), tipping.totalTippedBy(addr),
  tipping.totalReceivedBy(addr), or scan Tipped events from the deploy block.
- Reverse lookup: tipping.handleOf(address) returns the handle, "" if none.
